An editorial illustration features a man in a white turban and a white mask positioned under his chin. He wears glasses and has a concentrated expression. His portrait is seen through a circular lens effect with black crosshairs centered on his face. He is slightly angled towards the right. 

The background is a dark, out-of-focus crowd. The word "TEMPO" is written in large, black capital letters behind the man's head, partially obscured. Above the title, text reads "INVESTASI JUMBO MOBIL LISTRIK" on the left and "TOKOH SENI DAN SASTRA PILIHAN" on the right. Below the title, "50 Tahun!" is written in a cursive font. 

At the bottom left, bold white text reads "SETELAH FPI DILARANG". Below it, a paragraph states: "Pemerintah membekukan rekening bank dan menurunkan konten Front Pembela Islam di media sosial. Perintah langsung Presiden Jokowi?" 

The bottom right contains a date "11-17 JANUARI 2021," a price, a barcode, and a QR code. The entire image is framed by a black background with a red vertical border on the left.
